notes.title: Important Update-V0.91.5

tags.feature: [*] Added 5 new treasures;
[*] Added new summon: Black Hole;
[*] Introduced an exclusive infinite mode monster (spawns only in Infinite Challenge);

tags.balance_change: [*] Reworked treasure "Diamond Pickaxe": "1. Damage to Brick 100%, 2. For every 2% of your Damage to Brick, Damage to Monster +1%";
[*] Freeze effect rebalance: Now also slows enemy movement skills;
[*] AI upgrades: Normal monsters now exhibit more aggressive attack patterns;

tags.feature: [*] Completely revamped freeze VFX for monsters;
[*] New thrust sound effects for the "Spear" summon;
[*] Performance boost: Optimized multiple VFX
[*] Dynamic UI scaling: Item effect text now auto-adjusts to fit container size;

notes.title: Import Update-Demo-0.91.0

tags.feature: Remade the game logo on the menu panel;
Remade all UI widgets on the battle panel and unify the panel's color scheme;
Remade the texture of most of the terrain bricks and optimized the material performance;
Optimized the lighting performance of some levels to avoid overexposure;
Remade some font colors and styles to make the UI more suitable;
After upgrading, players will not immediately open the treasure selection panel, but will open after playing effects;
Added level icons in the interactive panel of the portal;
When the player is healed, play a health healing sound effect;

tags.balance_change: Slightly shrunk the player's collision box;
Slightly increased the movement speed of some monsters;

tags.feature: Optimized the serialization of the archive system (which may cause inability to use historical battle archives);
Version name rules revised;

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where some treasures could not appear on the treasure selection panel；

notes.title: Import Update-0.90.0

tags.feature: - Remade all UI widgets of the main battle HUD;
- Remade the texture of most of the terrain bricks;
- Optimized the lighting performance of some levels to avoid excessive brightness;
- Remade font colors and styles to make the UI more suitable;
- After upgrading, players will not immediately open the treasure selection panel, but will open after playing effects;

tags.balance_change: - Slightly reduced the player's collision box;

tags.feature: - When the player's health is healed, add a health healing sound effect;
- Added framework support for minion system;
- New treasure has been added for testing minion system;

tags.bug: - Optimized the serialization of the archive system (which may result in the unavailability of historical battle archives);

tags.feature: - Version name rules revised;
